Seven-card stud it is. House rules: everyone antes 10, betting is fixed-limit (10 on third and fourth street, 20 from fifth street on), and there's no bring-in, so the highest up card acts first. You and the house have both put in the ante, so the pot is 20 and you have 990 left.

On third street your 9♠ beats my 4♦, so you act first. You're holding 9♥ K♣ in the hole, which gives you **a pair of nines** right away.
